answer: Sealed Reputation Inheritance: each identity’s standing passes to successors through an encrypted handle; the velvet handoff stays hidden until a challenge. A whisper from any peer triggers a reveal, forcing the clone to prove its handle predates the challenge. A plume of prior work must also match the inherited record. Clones mint fresh handles that fail both checks, so each attempt costs a full onboarding deposit plus forfeited accrued standing.
